async def claim(self, checkout_id, confirmation_ref, request_key, request_hash, *, authorization=None):
        if not isinstance(confirmation_ref, str) or not confirmation_ref:
            reject("Missing trusted confirmation reference", "H50_CONFIRMATION_MISSING", 403)
        # Hook precedes any write lock so a legal update can win the race.
        await self.hook("before_claim", checkout_id)
        # Acquire the actual shared DB write lock without blocking the event loop.
        # A busy SQLite writer yields a typed retryable denial, never raw 500.
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path, timeout=0)) as conn:
            conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            try:
                conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
                if conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM h50_attempts WHERE checkout_id=?", (checkout_id,)).fetchone():
                    reject("Checkout has an existing payment attempt")
                record = conn.execute("SELECT * FROM h50_confirmations WHERE confirmation_ref=?", (confirmation_ref,)).fetchone()
                if record is None or record["checkout_id"] != checkout_id:
                    reject("Unknown trusted confirmation", "H50_CONFIRMATION_INVALID", 403)
                if record["revoked"] or record["expires_at"] <= self.now():
                    reject("Confirmation revoked or expired", "H50_CONFIRMATION_INACTIVE", 403)
                row = conn.execute("SELECT data,status FROM checkouts WHERE id=?", (checkout_id,)).fetchone()
                if row is None or row["status"] in ("completed", "canceled"):
                    reject("Checkout missing or terminal")

conn.execute("INSERT INTO h50_attempts VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                             (checkout_id, payment_ref, canonical(snapshot), "IN_FLIGHT", request_key, request_hash))
                conn.execute("INSERT INTO h53_authorizations VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",
                             (checkout_id, validated["token_sha256"], validated["checkout_sha256"],
                              validated["confirmation_ref"], validated["decision"]))
                await self.hook("before_claim_commit", checkout_id)
                conn.commit()
            except sqlite3.OperationalError as exc:
                conn.rollback()
                if "locked" in str(exc).lower() or "busy" in str(exc).lower():
                    reject("Checkout write lock busy; retry after reconciliation", "H50_CLAIM_BUSY")
                raise
            except BaseException:
                conn.rollback()
                raise
        await self.hook("after_claim_commit", checkout_id)
        return {"payment_ref": payment_ref, "snapshot": snapshot}

async def reserve_stock(
  session: AsyncSession, product_id: str, quantity: int
) -> bool:
  """Atomically decrements inventory if sufficient stock exists."""
  stmt = (
    update(Inventory)
    .where(Inventory.product_id == product_id)
    .where(Inventory.quantity >= quantity)
    .values(quantity=Inventory.quantity - quantity)
  )
  result = await session.execute(stmt)
  return result.rowcount > 0

async def revoke(self, confirmation_ref):
        # Nonblocking acquisition: an open order transaction cannot stall the loop.
        # Revocation that loses the lock is not applied; caller receives 409.
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.path, timeout=0)) as conn:
            try:
                conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")
                conn.execute("UPDATE h50_confirmations SET revoked=1 WHERE confirmation_ref=?", (confirmation_ref,))
                conn.commit()
            except sqlite3.OperationalError as exc:
                conn.rollback()

    order object itself (``#/components/schemas/order``). This sample also sends
    an ``X-Event-Type`` extension header, but it is not part of the UCP webhook
    contract and conforming receivers cannot require it. The body must always be
    a valid order, so no notification is sent when there is no order to deliver.

    ``Content-Digest``/``Signature-Input``/``Signature`` cover the exact raw
    body bytes sent on the wire. Failed deliveries (transport errors or a
    5xx from the receiver) are retried with bounded exponential backoff
    (order.md: businesses MUST retry failed webhook deliveries); a 4xx is a
    permanent rejection and is not retried. Delivery failures are logged and
    never propagate into the order flow.
    """
    if not checkout.platform or not checkout.platform.webhook_url:
      return

    order_data = None
    if checkout.order and checkout.order.id:
      order_data = await db.get_order(
        self.transactions_session, checkout.order.id

    # must be the same bytes.

async def reserve_stock(
  session: AsyncSession, product_id: str, quantity: int
) -> bool:
  """Atomically decrements inventory if sufficient stock exists."""
  stmt = (
    update(Inventory)
    .where(Inventory.product_id == product_id)
    .where(Inventory.quantity >= quantity)
    .values(quantity=Inventory.quantity - quantity)
  )
  result = await session.execute(stmt)
  return result.rowcount > 0
